reviews.author: Brandy Fulk
reviews.text: Derrick has done both manor and major repairs/maintenance on my cars. He has always been up front and honest, He is both professional and down home. You could not ask for a better Mechanic. I will be referring him to everybody.

reviews.author: Mike Essick
reviews.text: Love these guys went there thinking I was going to need a window motor, but Derrick stop what he was doing and looked at my car and told me all I needed was a little silicone spray now it working better than it ever has. I wouldn't take my car anywhere else !

reviews.author: John Gentry
reviews.text: This place is a little hard to find in king it is located on Kirby road behind Community Eye and two buildings away from King Radiator. It is a two vehicle shop with a large sign on too with the name but no indication of where to enter the shop or office. If you walk to the side a little, you'll see the only entry door. It's a typical shop with two lifts and an oil pit, two guys work there. Can't remember their names yet but I've taken my vehicle there a few times and they haven't fed me a bunch of B's nor tries to over charge me. The other shops locally have some issues and I won't be taking anything I own back to any of them because of it.

reviews.author: michael bartorelli
reviews.text: Very professional, friendly, and knowledgeable. They preformed an NC safety inspection. Will definitely recommend their service!

reviews.author: joe jackson
reviews.text: Reasonable prices,they replaced my transmission in a very timely manner. I highly recommend them,I will use them again on the future
